messages.subject: Project Juniper - engagement
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Gordon,

Great to speak earlier. As discussed, I attach our engagement letter for the Wexbourne logistics arrangement (Project Juniper). James Osei will lead the drafting day to day, with Elena Marchetti supporting.

If you're happy with the terms, please sign and return the enclosed copy and we'll get going on the heads of terms. Our fee estimate to signature is £38k-£52k plus VAT.

Kind regards,
Sarah

Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
